summary: PT Telkom Indonesia (Persero) Tbk filed a 6-K disclosing that on September 17, 2026 it acquired all shares of PT Sigma Cipta Caraka (Telkomsigma) held in PT Telkom Data Ekosistem (TDE), comprising 1,445,020 Series A and 2,015,637,361,776 Series B shares, or 19.19% of TDE, taking Telkom's ownership to 100% via a 10,504,517,594,408-share position. No price per share, premium, advisor, or close date was stated; Telkom calls it an affiliate transaction under POJK 42/2020 with no conflict of interest and no material financial impact, part of its 'Unlock DC Co' streamlining. Watch for any follow-on stake sale or partnership pricing.
